discussions.subject: Group Formation & Pre- Workshop Reminder
discussions.message:
Dear Students,

I hope you're doing well.

This is a gentle reminder to please form groups of four for the upcoming presentations in Week 6. Kindly email me the names of your group members.

I've also included a link to the McKinsey report we discussed yesterday, "Geopolitics and the Geometry of Global Trade: 2026 Update" — https://www.mckinsey.com/mgi/our-research/geopolitics-and-the-geometry-of-global-trade-2026-update

Lastly, please make sure to go through the slides and recording ahead of next week's lecture, so we can have an engaging discussion in class.

Thank you very much for your cooperation.

Best,
Navneet
